{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for the QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
defective_rows = df[df['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print(f'Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(defective_rows)}')

defective_rows.head()"}
